defaults.setup: Load the reviewed literal byte and canonical-preimage vectors without calling the Breakdown implementation to form expectations.
defaults.action: Exercise the packaged core dispatcher on equivalent real project bytes and compare returned and stored digests to the literals.

rows.oracle: Empty, binary, and text raw bytes match the reviewed lowercase SHA-256 literals from byte zero through EOF.
Byte-level definition/JSON changes alter raw digests while root and filesystem metadata changes preserve them.
Every reviewed canonical JCS preimage hashes to its literal context_sha256 across operation paths.
Changing each included factor independently changes the expected Node Context to the indexed literal vector.
Changing each excluded factor independently leaves the baseline Node Context digest unchanged.
The checked-in literal catalog contains every required raw, JCS, normalization, inclusion, and exclusion vector.
